notes.title: Language Update (v1.2)
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30827318/f89ab745591d30151ddbc5a219ad4d48ff3acc88.jpg

New supported languages for Deserving Life!
We are pleased to announce part one of our update for supported languages.
Special thanks to the translators who made this possible:

Danish - Victor Fisker
Czech - XzibitusaK
Portuguese-Brazil - Marcus Vinicius Santos
Spanish - Juan "Psycho Kurt" Buleo
Bulgarian - Todor Ilkov

And even more languages are on the way!

If you find any flaws or mistakes in the translations, please feel free to share your findings in the LANGUAGES THREAD. Thank you for your help!

Bug Fixes
- Candle can't be taken with you down to the hallway anymore
- Fixed a bug where important objects wouldn't teleport back after leaving the playspace.
- Fixed a bug where you were able to open the gate in the basement without solving the bullet riddle.
- Some minor bug fixes

notes.title: SteamVR Home Collectible for Deserving Life
notes.content:
Deserving Life just received a Collectible Item which you can place in your SteamVR Home Environment.

Pizza is Life!
Check out the kidnappers delicious leftover:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30827318/2b53ec60d020107d83c035ba318679b9f7095203.png

Upcoming Announcement
A new patch containing bug fixes and an announcement will follow on the 13th of November.


Best Regards!
